title: Serre's quasi-compact vanishing criterion
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Assume that $X$ is quasi-compact and that $H^1(X,\mathcal I)=0$ for every quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ [pqf-def-coherent, pqf-def-cohomology]. Then $X$ is affine.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma Tag 01XF (label lemma-quasi-compact-h1-zero-covering), lines 283-388
